text:
Leah: Planning note 1: We need a concise nurture flow + send plan for the Q2 benchmark release. Focus: drive qualified webinar signups and downloads without spamming freemium users.
Omar: Agreed. Proposed segmentation: Enterprise (acct tier = enterprise), Power-trial (api_calls > 1k/wk), Active-startups (employees <50 & recent_engagement), General newsletter.
Priya: For Active-startups, prefer a soft invite (digest first) and only push hard webinar CTA if they click through the benchmark. Keep 2-email cadence, 4 days apart.
Ben: Deliverability note: rotate seed domains and include a 500-recipient warmup chunk (monitor complaints). Use stagger windows: NA mornings, EMEA afternoons, APAC evenings.
Dana: Creative: hero GIF + 15s clip link. Also include a 1-line outcome at top: "Median inference cost down 2.1x across workloads". That should be the opener.
Leah: Routing rules draft (mini):
```
if tier==enterprise -> send: webinar_invite (primary), followup: recording + worksheet
elif api_calls_week > 1000 -> send: webinar_invite + advanced_playbook
elif newsletter_only -> send: benchmark_brief -> if click -> invite
else -> reengage_series (opt-out link)
```
Omar: Subject line A/B suggestions: A) "Q2 Benchmark: Cut inference spend by 2x — live walkthrough" B) "Benchmark + configs: webinar + downloadable kit". Run on Enterprise and Power-trial.
Priya: Preheader options: short  "See configs & quantized profiles" vs "Join a walkthrough & grab the kit". I'll produce 4 variants.
Ben: Tracking: utm_campaign=benchmark_q2, utm_medium=email, utm_content={sub_variant}. Events: download_benchmark, webinar_reg. Add header for seed-checks.
Dana: Ops ask: can we gate webinar seats to prevent overload? Only allow open registration to Enterprise and Power-trial; others get waitlist unless they download the brief.
Leah: Yes. Also add SMS nudges only for trial accounts that opted in. For pacing, chunk sends at 8k/hour with 10m pause after each chunk for health checks.
Omar: Add industry microcopy for infra/search/agents. Personalize first line based on industry. That usually increases clicks.
Priya: Timeline: creative by Wed EOD, subject + preheaders Thu morning, seed send Thu noon, small proof Thu afternoon, full soft blast Mon to early cohorts, broad send Tue 10ET. Reminder 24h and 1h before webinar only to engaged users.
Ben: I'll set up deliverability dashboard and blocklist checks. I'll also prepare rollback playbook in case complaints spike.
Dana: I'll hand off hero gif + mp4 + fallback image by Wed. Make sure all assets are under the shared drive link.
Leah: Nice. One more thing: add an experiment to swap out the top-line metric for a customer quote vs metric for a 10% sample to see what resonates. 
Omar: Good idea. We'll A/B that on the newsletter_only segment.
Priya: I'll own the nurture copy and the waitlist flow. Will post the Google Sheet with routing tags when ready.
Leah: Thanks team  I'll assemble final routing CSV and post it here when done. :tada:
